import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Color palette for species
palette = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=palette[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, color=palette[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Box plot: Distribution of Petal Length by Species
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df_melted = df.melt(id_vars=['species'], value_vars=['petal_length'], 
                     var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=palette, ax=ax3, width=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Violin plot: Distribution of Sepal Length by Species
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='sepal_length', palette=palette, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sepal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Species Classification: Comprehensive Analysis of Morphological Features', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
